formations.method: 三外线两内线半场站位（英尺，进攻向右）：弧顶持球 24.45 ft、两侧翼 26.05 ft，三个外线点全部在三分线外，接球投篮因此来自外线；低位点站篮下 8.80 ft、顺下点站篮下 8.05 ft，两个内线点都站在三秒区边缘而不是篮下，站定出手因此不会直接变成扣篮
formations.script: hand-authored formation geometry, reviewed against the shot zone shares
formations.source: modern four-out one-in half-court spacing; four perimeter slots and one interior slot

freethrow.method: 回合事件文本里的 Free Throw 行逐次计数

policy.method: coordinate descent on the induced shot and possession distributions; parameter groups are declared in scripts/calibrate/fit_policy.py and each group owns its own bounds
policy.source: restored from the pre-failure-fit snapshot (scripts/calibrate/fit_policy.py --group all, 2026-10-26)

possession.method: 按回合起始语境分组统计结局速率与时长分位；封盖与抢断按事件文本上的（比赛、球员、计数）去重后逐场计数；封盖写作 `X BLOCK (n BLK)`，抢断写作 `X STEAL (n STL)`，两种词序都计入；and-1 取联盟场均参考值，事件文本里没有 and-1 标记

rebound.method: 分区相对差异来自事件文本的首次投失归组；总水平取 possession 表的 oreb_per_miss 后按分区投失占比等比缩放
rebound.source: shufinskiy/nba_data pbpstats possession table + event text

shot_make.contest: modeled: centred at 0.5 so the fitted mean is preserved; sensitivity documented in table
shot_make.method: empirical make rate per (shot kind, distance bin, two/three), sparse cells smoothed toward the same-distance-band rate and forced monotone decreasing in distance

shot_profile.method: 投篮档案逐球统计出手类型、区域与来源份额，按样本数归一
